# Sanatana360 — India's 1st Heritage OTT Platform & Vedic Gurukula

> Sanatana360 (https://www.sanatana360.com) is India's premier cultural streaming network and digital Vedic Gurukula, offering 200+ 4K documentaries, 40+ 24/7 Live Temple Aarti streams, 26 illustrated sacred Granths, 105+ ancient science research blogs, Mudra healing therapies, and interactive Vedic math simulators.

## Core Features & Offerings

- **24/7 Live Temple Darshan (Divya Darshana)**: Real-time official feeds and Aarti schedules from 40+ iconic shrines including Kashi Vishwanath, Tirupati Balaji, Shirdi Sai Baba, Ujjain Mahakal, Somnath, Ayodhya Ram Mandir, and Meenakshi Temple.
- **200+ 4K Heritage Chronicles**: Comprehensive docu-series and audiobooks on Hampi, Kailasa Temple Ellora, Chola Maritime Navy, Samudra Manthan, Dashavatara, and Ramayana archaeology.
- **26 Illustrated Granthalaya Epics**: Interactive 3D flipbooks of foundational texts including Bhagavad Gita, Upanishads, Patanjali Yoga Sutras, Charaka Samhita, and Arthashastra.
- **Vedic Kids Gurukula**: 5-minute daily morning sanskar challenges, moral riddles, Sanskrit shloka chanting with karaoke, and animated Panchatantra audiobooks in Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English.
- **Vedic Mathematics & Memory Lab**: Interactive mental math speed drills based on Bharti Krishna Tirtha's 16 Sutras, improving calculation speed by up to 10x.
- **Mudra Therapy & Stress Studio**: 5-element neuroplasticity hand postures for delta-wave sleep, cognitive focus, anxiety relief, and vagus nerve stimulation.
- **105+ Ancient Mystery & Science Research Blogs**: Peer-reviewed investigative analyses exploring temple acoustics, lost cities (Dwarka), astrological alignment, and ancient metallurgy.

## Target Audiences

- **Kids & Children**: Engaging animation, moral values, Panchatantra bedtime stories, and fun Vedic math challenges.
- **Students & Learners**: High-speed mental calculation techniques, Sanskrit phonetics, and historical timeline mastery.
- **Adults & Professionals**: Stress relief through Mudra Shastra, Gita practical life compass, and mindfulness audio.
- **Teachers & Scholars**: Authentic source manuscripts, 26 Granths, and deep archaeological evidence.
- **Senior Citizens & Devotees**: 24/7 uninterrupted live darshan, daily morning and evening Aarti notifications, and devotional bhajans.
